purpose: Check whether an independent open-source DWG implementation decodes the bounded AC1032 ACDBASSOCNETWORK candidates into the same typed fields and reference roles as libdxfrw.

sources.provenance: Public Autodesk ObjectARX forum attachment. Embedded APPINFO reports AutoCAD 2024 build U.61.0.0(x64); this is not signed or independently verified producer attestation.

constraintGroup.remainingTypedValues: Acadrust emits typed node bodies, including points, curves, connections, and scalar parameters. Its source layout is independent implementation evidence; these values are not producer-authenticated semantic truth.

sources.provenance: LibreDWG repository test drawing; producer provenance is not established.

independentReader.result: DwgReader returned AC1032 CadDocument values; each listed network was ObjectType::Associative with AssociativeData::Network, rather than a raw Unknown object. The listed typed values agree with the source-bound libdxfrw candidates and the previously recorded LibreDWG comparison.

fields: registered node IDs, class indexes and names, statuses, registry flags, connections, and exact bounded body spans
group root ID, connection count, and flag
bounded-line dependency handle role, node ID, point, direction, ray flag, and endpoints
arc dependency handle role, node ID, center, normal, direction, radius, curve parameters, reserved value, and trim points
all implicit-point dependency roles, handles, optional-point states, point types and indexes, and curve IDs
point-curve, center-point, and tangent owner/implied/active values
constraintGroupComparison.result: All values exposed by the current candidate model for the observed node classes match the independent typed acadrust output. This is one source comparison and not source-profile, semantic, or output qualification.

comparison.odaSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, SHA-256 1ed2e02722862188120da606e4b6a816fa4014c96de68da2f84a2ecda09461e7; local text extraction contains no class-specific ACDBASSOCNETWORK layout.
comparison.agreement: The same distinct base and network action indexes are retained for both AC1032 class-version-2 network records. Network version, action index/count, owned flags, action handles, owning-network handles and dictionary owners agree across typed source observations.

procedure.sourceFixturePolicy: Both DWGs were read in place and were not copied into or committed to libdxfrw. The probe source, crate cache and executable remain under /private/tmp.
procedure.validationResult: Focused CTest passed 1/1 in 0.18 seconds; the hash-bound physical candidate selector exited 0 against the forum source. The separate libdxfrw associative graph-closure selector also passed against that source.

limits: The independent reader's schema is implementation evidence, not the ODA specification or a controlled producer witness.
The forum attachment's embedded AutoCAD metadata is not authenticated provenance; the LibreDWG test drawing's producer is unknown.
The reader comparison does not establish native constraint evaluation, complete graph semantics, output compatibility, or general AC1032 support.
Keep m_networkFieldsParsed false and AC1032 network output refused until the source-profile and semantic gates in P4 pass.

implementation.change: Compare all fields exposed by the bounded candidate model for this source against the independent typed acadrust output. Fix the omitted Geometrical data-kind classification for AC1032 point-curve, center-point and tangent candidate nodes; keep their class bodies partial and output refused.
